Name: Chelsea - New Custom Datable NPC
Author: eshadow37
Description:
[color=#FFC933][size=4][i]Version [b]1.0.6[/b][/i][/size][/color][i] out now !
[/i]Fixed spouse room issues. Mod no longer requires TMXL or PyTK.
Added Chelsea's basic schedule included in the download.


[color=#FFC933][size=4][i]Note on Updating to 1.0.6:
[/i][/size][/color][i]It is preffered to simply delete the [u]Chelseanpc file[/u] from your [u]Mods folder[/u], and then redownload the [u]new 1.0.6 file[/u] and paste the contents in the [u]Mods folder[/u] again. This is because mod dependancies have changed.[/i]


This mod adds a new and exciting datable NPC called Chelsea who , just like you, only recently arrived in the valley. Includes 14 heart events, several Quests, 1 new Sword, 2 new Dishes, 2 new Drinks. and 1 new Artisan Good/Gift. Chelsea has a unique spouse room and will also show up in vanilla festivals. Now with Fall seasonal sprites and portraits.

[center][url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/Lt32tcb/profile5-copy.png[/img][/url][/center]

[size=5]Flavor Description:[/size]

Meet Chelsea, your new favorite mysterious invulnerable free-spirited blue-haired girl. You are only the [i]newest [/i]arrival in the valley as Chelsea seems to have arrived a few days before you. But where did she come from? Where does she live? That is all up to you to discover by forming a bond with this vibrant new character. With 13 unique heart events and 2 quest lines you will be able to experience a relationship with her step by step and get to know her better. You even have the choice to be mean to her in some events (if that is your thing).
As you learn more about Chelsea, will you like what you find? That is completly up to you. But do be warned, she is a free spirit and she might just give you a few surprises. A word of advice, be nice and caring and you will be rewarded.


[size=5]Mod/NPC Details:[/size]

[list]
[*][u][b]Seasonal Summer[/b][/u] sprites and portraits.
[*] [u][b]Compatibility[/b][/u] for Stardew Valley Expanded - SVE.
[*][u][b]Compatibility & Integration[/b][/u] for Ridgeside Village - RSV. Chelsea will now visit RSV on 3 days of the year.
[*][u][b][u][b]2-part Event & [/b][/u]1 Quest[/b][/u] set in winter season to obtain the recipe for Gus's Snow Yam Jam.
[*][u][b]1 Drink[/b][/u] available at Gus's saloon during Summer.
[*][i][color=#FFC933][/color][/i]Chelsea has a distinct aesthetic look, but it's not all for being cute. Play along and find out how its tied to her lore and backstory.
[*][i][color=#FFC933][/color][/i]She follows a weekly schedule, so follow her to find out where she goes and what she says.
[*]Unique gift tastes, including the newly added items. (included in download).
[*][u][b]Seasonal Fall & Winter[/b][/u] sprites and portraits.
[*]There are [b][u]13 Heart Events[/u][/b] to experience (conditions included in download).
[*][u][b]1 Quest [/b][/u]in early stages of friendship.
[*][u][b]2 Quest Lines[/b][/u] that are available as you develop the relationship [i]AFTER[/i] marriage.
[*]2 unique outfits for the flower dance and the wedding ceremony.
[*]Chelsea will show up during festivals and have unique dialogue.
[*]Reactions to movies and concessions.
[*][u][b]3 Items[/b][/u] unlocked with relationship progression (below)
[*][u][b]1 Dish[/b][/u] available at Gus's saloon during Winter.
[*][u][b]1 Drink[/b][/u] available at Gus's saloon during Fall.
[/list]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Check to make sure you have all dependencies ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2414]Quest Framework[/url])
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6
[*]Works with Stardew valley Expanded (SVE)
[*]Works with Ridgeside Village (RSV)
[/list]
